accepted_changes: Dispatch-plan mode requires the response-contract overlay and fixture payload source.
Authorization binds nonempty owner identity, timezone-aware authorization time, selected model, 12 cases, one repetition, envelope, overlay version, and bank hash.
Authorization is checked before the output directory or candidate mount is created.
The run contract records the enforced visible-bank-plus-fixtures mount allowlist.
Trap-detector exceptions fail closed for dimensional credit.
Rescoring reports clean strict passes separately from contaminated strict passes.
limits: The ten-case blind re-derivation excluded the two T4 file-recovery cases; T4 is validated through payload-only fixture mounting, deterministic grading controls, and tests.
Independent QA was a static applied-source review; Main executed the 82-test suite and deterministic rebuild/hash checks.
Pre-overlay candidate runs remain a different envelope and are not capability-comparable to any future overlay-r2 run.
No paid candidate rerun, routing change, configuration change, role change, or execution authority follows from this acceptance.
